text:
Describe the solution as the planned complete experience. Hindi belongs to the set of 22 scheduled languages. Retaining English makes 23 language choices in total. Support includes speech recognition, understandable responses, spoken output and interface localization. The information provided is preliminary, with case-specific advice handled by an advocate.

text:
The Eighth Schedule lists 22 languages. English is not in that list, so retaining English while covering every scheduled language implies 23 language options in total. Names use common contemporary spellings. A scheduled language can use more than one script, and regional accents require separate testing. Do not equate a translated menu with validated end-to-end voice support.

Sources: https://www.mha.gov.in/sites/default/files/Eighth_Schedule.pdf

text:
Explain the system as a target architecture. The browser captures user input and displays returned responses. The Express server calls AI and language providers, performs matching, manages records and coordinates payments. MongoDB does not call providers directly. Authentication, consent records and reliable payment status handling are part of the proposed implementation. Provider choices remain subject to evaluation. The response node represents presentation of returned results, not a second independent application.

ASR converts speech to text. TTS generates spoken output. Compare direct multilingual analysis with translation-based processing for each language. Validation checks structure and preservation of facts, but it cannot guarantee legal correctness. Include qualified review and uncertainty handling. Use the same scenario across languages to compare results. No model accuracy or response-time result is claimed.

text:
Technical feasibility relies on mature application technologies, but language quality and live service availability still require testing. BHASHINI is one candidate ecosystem to evaluate, not a guaranteed fit for all modalities. Measure cost per completed case from audio duration, API usage, model tokens, hosting allocation and retries. Payment and consultation costs are separate. No profit margin, budget, timeline or benchmark is supplied. Agree acceptance thresholds with faculty and reviewers before evaluation. Test provider outages, noisy audio, mixed-language input and payment failures.

Sources: https://bhashini.gov.in/

text:
Expected beneficiaries include people seeking initial legal orientation, users more comfortable speaking than typing and advocates receiving consultation requests. Evaluate benefits through task completion, comprehension checks, matching relevance and successful bookings. Do not claim reduced court backlog, faster judgments or measured social impact without evidence.
